dataset.name: frozen COCO val2017 first-10 subset
dataset.calibration_source: COCO128 train2017 (first 128 images, no overlap with eval subset)
dataset.calibration_method: preprocessed .npy arrays via vision contract preprocessing (DetectionProcessor)

configuration_sweep.summary: Six NNCF configurations were tested. The MIXED preset with 128 calibration images achieved near-parity mAP (0.440735 vs 0.442554 reference) but still fails the score_delta gate (0.244714 > 0.1). SmoothQuant alpha tuning (0.3, 0.5, 0.7) produced identical outputs to plain MIXED, indicating the quantization is already at its accuracy ceiling for this graph. overflow_fix=enable made results worse (mAP 0.415147). The original PERFORMANCE preset with 10 calibration images (prior FAIL evidence) collapsed mAP to 0.009996; expanding to 128 images improved PERFORMANCE to mAP 0.079 but still far below parity.

performance_10cal_prior.note: Prior FAIL evidence: PERFORMANCE preset, 10 calibration images

performance_128cal.verdict: FAIL - 35 more calibration images did not fix score collapse

mixed_128cal.verdict: FAIL (score_delta gate) - mAP and high-confidence parity achieved but max score delta on 1 detection exceeds 0.1

mixed_ignored_scope.verdict: FAIL (score_delta gate) - identical mAP to mixed; ignoring softmax/sigmoid/topK quantization does not change the one problematic detection

mixed_smoothquant_0.3.verdict: FAIL - identical to plain MIXED (SmoothQuant has no effect on this graph)

failure_analysis.root_cause: OpenVINO NNCF INT8 post-training quantization compresses YOLO26n confidence scores. With the MIXED preset and 128 calibration images, mAP recovers to near-parity (drop 0.001819) and all high-confidence detections (score > 0.5) are preserved. However, INT8 quantization compresses one detection's score from 0.6222 to 0.3774 (delta 0.2447), crossing the 0.5 high-confidence boundary downward. This single score-delta exceeds the 0.1 gate.
failure_analysis.what_was_recovered: Switching from PERFORMANCE to MIXED preset (which keeps some sensitive layers in FP32) and expanding calibration from 10 to 128 images recovered mAP from 0.009996 to 0.440735 — a 44x improvement that demonstrates the quantization scheme, not the fundamental approach, was the bottleneck in the prior FAIL.
failure_analysis.what_still_fails: max_score_delta = 0.244714 (gate 0.1) on one detection whose reference score 0.6222 dropped to 0.3774. This is a genuine INT8 score-compression artifact that no tested configuration (SmoothQuant, ignored_scope, overflow_fix) resolves.
failure_analysis.score_compression_detail: 8 of 56 matched detections have score deltas > 0.1. The largest (0.2447) is a person detection (image 480985, category 1) whose score drops from 0.6222 to 0.3774. Mean score delta is 0.047023 (below gate), indicating most detections are well-preserved.
failure_analysis.localization_preserved: Mean IoU 0.969334, min IoU 0.915989, max IoU 0.988201 — all matched detections localize correctly. 0 class mismatches. 0 high-confidence false positives. The 4 false positives all have scores 0.27-0.30 (below high-confidence threshold).
failure_analysis.graph_topology_note: The YOLO26n end-to-end ONNX bakes NMS into the graph (Sigmoid, Softmax, TopK ops). Quantizing the confidence path through NMS is inherently sensitive. A raw-output graph (NMS external) would likely quantize more gracefully but is out of scope for this contract.

non_claims: Not a certification or signed result.

Not a claim that OpenVINO INT8 cannot work for YOLO26n; only that it failed under all tested NNCF configurations (PERFORMANCE, MIXED, MIXED+ignored_scope, MIXED+SmoothQuant, MIXED+overflow_fix) with 128 calibration images.
The MIXED preset achieves mAP parity (drop 0.001819 < 0.002 gate) but fails the per-detection score_delta gate (0.244714 > 0.1).
A raw-output (non-e2e) ONNX graph may quantize better but was not tested.
NNCF quantize_with_accuracy_control (iterative quantizer removal) was not tested because it requires a validation_fn callback for detection mAP, which is computationally expensive and out of scope.
More representative calibration data (full COCO val, 5000+ images) was not available locally in this environment.
TensorRT INT8 on Jetson remains a separate, untested target.
